messages.author: 44f306d161c049cf
messages.subject: trelliscope crashing in Windows
parts:
I have made some trelliscope displays in one vdb connection.  I copied the vdb folder to a share drive and my coworker is able to view the trelliscope displays using R (so no web syncing).  However, her R session repeatedly crashes and does so more quickly each time.  Meaning the first time she could view the displays for minutes to hours before R crashed.  Now it crashes nearly upon viewing the displays.  The only hint at the real problem that I have is that it may have something to do with Rsync.  Below are specifics regarding her machine and R session.  The crash occurs in Rstudio or regular R.
Let me know what else I can provide that might help clarify the problem and a possible solution.  Thank you for your efforts.  I use dataDR and Trelliscope daily now and my coworker will soon be doing the same.
Trenton
801-230-7499

 

# R code 

library(trelliscope)

library(datadr)

library(ggplot2)

library(reshape2)

library(GGally)

library(matlab)

 

conn=vdbConn("N:/Trenton/MissionaryOptimizeComplements/vdb1", name = "vdb1")

 

view()
